title: Workers cron triggers are over the free plan's 5 per account: a check that counts them before a deploy fails
problem: The Workers Free plan allows 5 cron triggers per account (developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/limits, 'Number of Cron Triggers per account | 5 | 1,000', read 2026-11-27). With the seller-books reminder cron (2026-11-27) the repository's Workers configure 6: ventures/payapps/apps/payapps, payapps-site, seller-books, seller-books-site, jobshop-quote and platform/email. Whichever deploys last fails its trigger update, and nothing in CI counts them, so a session adding a cron cannot see the budget.
evidence: grep '"crons"' over wrangler*.jsonc plus platform/email/wrangler.toml on 2026-11-27 main + the seller-books estimate-reminders PR: 6 schedules
Cloudflare limits page, read 2026-11-27: 5 per account on Free
change: A test (platform/ci) that lists every cron schedule in the repository's Worker configs and fails above 5 unless portfolio/hosting names the account as Workers Paid; and fold the two daily site crons (payapps-site 04:41, seller-books-site 04:23: both purge unconfirmed sign-ups) into their apps' own scheduled handlers, or one scheduler Worker calling the others through service bindings, so the count fits.
metric: configured cron schedules on the account's Workers, and deploy runs failing on a trigger update

history.note: Shipped the check (platform/ci/cron_budget.py, run by Portfolio validate). Recount found 8 configured, not 6 (cmmc and cmmc-site added crons), but only 3 on workflow-deployed Workers, so nothing is failing on the account today. The fold is split out as P098.
